title: New key new_area_seed_tiles parsed with jint: decimal truncation and >i32-range wrap silently accepted
detail: balance.json parses with parse_integers=true, so a decimal (e.g. 10.9) arrives as json.Float and jint silently truncates to 10; an integer above i32 range (e.g. 2^32+10) wraps through the unchecked i32 cast to 10 — both load clean instead of fail-fast (ODN-10 named-knob bar).
recommended_fix: Parse the new key with jint_strict (rejecting json.Float and out-of-i32-range values) like cap_fraction/terminal keys, and add a decimal + wrap loader test row naming the key.

title: Diameter guard only rejects seed floor ≥ map diagonal; a sub-diameter floor can be permanently unsatisfiable once terminals exist
detail: On the 40×30 map, seed=40 loads clean (1600 < 2500), but a terminal at (8,15) has max distance to any map point √1157 ≈ 34 — no candidate can clear 40, so all SEED attempts reject forever: the exact silent permanent stall the check's comment claims to prevent.
recommended_fix: Tighten the bound (e.g. seed must be ≤ half the map's smaller dimension, or emit a one-time warning/diagnostic when every attempt in N consecutive windows rejects on the seed predicate), distinguishing permanent stall from transient skips.
